title: Patrick AFB helicopter flies out to the light

tellings.quote:
we see one of the
helicopters from the Air Force base go
out to it.

plain: A witness named Charles says that around 2013, off Cocoa Beach in Florida, he and others watched a strange light. According to Charles, they saw a helicopter from the nearby Patrick Air Force Base, a US Air Force base on that coast, fly out toward it. He tells it because it suggests the military saw the light too and went to check.
